communitySignals: Papers with Code: no repo found
credibilityEvidence: Section 4: 4 benchmarks (Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling, ZebraLogic, SciBench Math, GPQA) x 3 baseline classes (direct LLM, baseline planner, SOTA incl. PlanGEN/ToT/BoN)

Section 4.2: honest null result reported on GPQA
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Covers single-task and multi-task-scaling experiments, ablations, and token/cost analysis across multiple backbones; supports the paper's bounded claim on the tested benchmarks but not a general planning-superiority claim (GPQA null result)
